description: Pyth Current Price. Calls only GET /v4/oracle/pyth/pricefeeds/{priceFeedAddress}/price and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching the current Pyth oracle price for any price feed on Solana. Returns price, confidence interval, and EMAP data in real-time.

priceFeedAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields. Path parameter for /v4/oracle/pyth/pricefeeds/{priceFeedAddress}/price.

name: get-pyth-price
title: Pyth Current Price
